units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 41:25">Targ. Is. XLI, 25</cite> <he>דעָרֵיךְ</he> (h. text <he>ירמס</he>).—
<cite ref="Menachot 56a:18">Men. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>דע׳ הוא ואפה הוא</he> when he himself kneaded and baked; <he>דעריך חבריה וכ׳</he> when his neighbor kneaded and gave it to him, and he baked.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 6:5:3">Y. Shebu. VI, 37ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אזלת מֵיעֲרוֹךְ גבי חבירתה</he> she went to knead her bread at her neighbor’s.—Part. pass. <cite ref="P01356"><he>עָרִיךְ</he></cite>, pl. <he>עֲרִיכִין</he> Ib.ᵇ top <he>אשכחון … ע׳ גו עיגולא</he> they found the two denars (that were missed) worked into the cake.

senses.gloss: to be worked in. Ib.ᵃ bot. אִיעַרְכוּ גו עיגולא, v. supra.
